title: Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Juniper is a startup building banking apps. We are looking for a mid-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Oldmoor office.

Our stack: kotlin, swift, dart. You will build offline-first features, own the release process and ship features end to end.

Four-day weeks in summer.
